requirements.quote: No `gh issue view|list --json` call in `bin/` requests `authorAssociation` [type:unit]
A test asserts every `--json` field list passed to `gh issue view|list` in `bin/` is drawn from the fields gh supports (a fixed allowlist of the fields gh 2.97 lists) [type:unit]
`forgedock orchestrate --add <id> N` adds an open issue on a real gh (regression test with a gh stub that rejects unknown fields the way gh does) [type:unit]
The body reader and issue-watch list still resolve the author's trust (the association comes from the REST or GraphQL field) [type:unit]
Each call asks only for fields that `gh` supports.
`bodyTrusted` / `isTrustedActor` keep their semantics, and a failed read still fails closed for trust.

deliverables.change: New module: ISSUE_JSON_FIELDS allowlist (gh 2.97 issue fields, no authorAssociation); issueAssociation(gh, repo, n) via `gh api repos/{repo}/issues/N --jq .author_association` (repo null => {owner}/{repo}); listAssociations(gh, repo) via one paginated REST list returning Map number->association. Any failure returns undefined/empty so trust fails closed.

Wiring only (import + calls; keep growth tiny, hotspot): drop authorAssociation from the --json lists at addToBatch (:1257) and the batch readBody (:1864/:1865); merge association from issueAssociation into the record before bodyTrusted/addedEdges.
Drop authorAssociation from the two `gh issue list --json` lists (:244, :273); merge listAssociations by number into each issue before classifyIssue.

New tests: scan non-test bin/**/*.mjs for gh issue view|list --json field lists and assert each is within ISSUE_JSON_FIELDS (and none has authorAssociation); helper unit tests incl. fail-closed; strict gh stub rejecting unknown fields drives addToBatch (orchestrate --add adds an open issue) and the readBody trust path; issuewatch tick still claims a trusted-author issue and skips an untrusted one.
Update gh mock to serve the REST association call (api) instead of the authorAssociation JSON key; keep the untrusted-author case.
Update gh mocks for the REST association list call; same trust assertions.
Update gh mocks for the association call if its io.gh stub handles issue list.

preserve.what: bodyTrusted/isTrustedActor semantics (bin/engine-cli.mjs:2230, bin/engine/phases.mjs:63): untrusted or unreadable association is untrusted.
classifyIssue results (bin/lean/issuewatch.mjs:145) for the same issue records, including the bot/spoof cases in bin/lean/issuewatch.test.mjs.
`--json comments` reads of authorAssociation (bin/lean/prefilter.mjs, bin/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs) are valid and unchanged.
orchestrate --add output format and edge report (bin/engine-cli.mjs addToBatch/addedEdges).

decisions.choice: Get the association from REST (`gh api ... author_association`), not GraphQL.
decisions.justification: Issue's Expected section offers either; REST has precedent at bin/engine-cli.mjs:1922 and needs no query string; one paginated list call serves issue watch.

decisions.choice: New module bin/lean/gh-assoc.mjs instead of growing engine-cli.mjs.
decisions.justification: engine-cli.mjs is a 2467-line hotspot; it gets only wiring.

repro_test.id: gh issue --json field lists stay within the gh allowlist
